title: IELTS Part 1: Life in Your Neighborhood
prompt:
IELTS Speaking Part 1. Answer these questions naturally.
1. What do you usually do in your neighborhood after work or school?
2. Is there a place nearby that you visit regularly?
3. How has your neighborhood changed in recent years?
sample_answer:
Q1: I normally take a short walk after dinner because it helps me clear my head. I often see the same people walking their dogs.
Q2: Yes, I stop at a tiny fruit shop on the corner. The owner remembers what I like, which makes shopping there pleasant.
Q3: Several older houses have become cafés and small offices. The streets are livelier now, although traffic is noticeably heavier during the evening rush.
tips_md:
**IELTS Part 1 – khu dân cư:**
- Câu 1 mở bằng một thói quen cụ thể với **normally** hoặc **usually**, rồi giải thích tác dụng.
- Câu 2 thêm một chi tiết cá nhân như người bán quen để câu trả lời có màu sắc tự nhiên.
- Câu 3 đối chiếu **used to be** và **now**; nêu cả thay đổi tích cực lẫn bất tiện nếu phù hợp.
- Mỗi câu khoảng 15–20 giây, trả lời trực tiếp trước khi triển khai chi tiết.

title: IELTS Part 1: Caring for Plants
prompt:
IELTS Speaking Part 1. Talk about plants in everyday life.
1. Do you keep any plants at home?
2. Did you learn anything about plants when you were a child?
3. Would you like to grow your own vegetables in the future?
sample_answer:
Q1: I have two small herbs on my kitchen windowsill. They do not need much space, but I have to remember to water them.
Q2: My grandfather showed me how to plant beans in recycled cups. I was amazed when the first leaves appeared.
Q3: Definitely. I would like to grow tomatoes on a balcony someday. Even a small harvest would make cooking feel more rewarding.
tips_md:
**IELTS Part 1 – cây xanh:**
- Dùng **I have**, **I used to** và **I would like to** để thể hiện hiện tại, quá khứ, dự định.
- Nếu chưa trồng cây, có thể nói thật rồi chuyển sang loại cây muốn thử; tránh tự tạo trải nghiệm phức tạp.
- Miêu tả bằng chi tiết nhỏ như **windowsill**, **water**, **first leaves** thay vì chỉ nói *interesting*.
- Luyện phát âm **herbs**, **vegetables** và âm cuối của **plants**.

title: IELTS Part 1: Apps You Actually Use
prompt:
IELTS Speaking Part 1. Answer questions about everyday apps.
1. Which app do you open most often?
2. Have you stopped using an app recently? Why?
3. Do you prefer learning a new app by exploring it or watching a tutorial?
sample_answer:
Q1: I probably open my calendar more than any other app. It keeps all my deadlines in one place and sends gentle reminders.
Q2: I deleted a shopping app last month because I was checking discounts too often. I did not really need most of the things it suggested.
Q3: I usually explore first. If I get stuck on an unfamiliar feature, I look for a short video showing exactly what to do.
tips_md:
**IELTS Part 1 – ứng dụng số:**
- Dùng ví dụ thật và một chức năng cụ thể để chứng minh lý do chọn ứng dụng.
- Câu 2 dùng **I stopped using... because...**, kết hợp quá khứ đơn với diễn giải tác động.
- Câu 3 so sánh hai cách học, nêu lựa chọn chính và lúc nào sử dụng cách còn lại.
- Tránh liệt kê tên nhiều ứng dụng; điểm mạnh nằm ở độ rõ ràng và tính liên kết.

title: IELTS Part 1: Eating Together
prompt:
IELTS Speaking Part 1. Talk about meals and company.
1. How often do you eat with other people?
2. What food do you enjoy sharing with friends?
3. Are family meals different now from when you were younger?
sample_answer:
Q1: I have dinner with my family most evenings. Even when we are busy, we try to sit together for at least half an hour.
Q2: I like sharing hotpot because everyone can choose their own ingredients and talk while the food cooks.
Q3: When I was little, we ate at the same time every day. Our schedules are less predictable now, so weekend lunches have become more important.
tips_md:
**IELTS Part 1 – bữa ăn chung:**
- Mở đầu bằng tần suất **most evenings**, **once a week**, rồi thêm chi tiết về thói quen.
- Với món ăn, giải thích **vì sao phù hợp để chia sẻ**, tránh chỉ kể tên món.
- Câu 3 dùng cặp **when I was little / these days** để tạo đối chiếu thời gian rõ ràng.
- Luyện cách nối ý tự nhiên bằng **even when**, **because**, **so**.

title: IELTS Part 1: Weather and Plans
prompt:
IELTS Speaking Part 1. Answer these weather-related questions.
1. What kind of weather helps you concentrate?
2. Have you ever changed your plans because of the weather?
3. Do you check the forecast before leaving home?
sample_answer:
Q1: I work best on cool, slightly cloudy days. Bright sunshine is lovely outdoors, but it can make my room uncomfortable in the afternoon.
Q2: Yes. A sudden storm once forced my friends and me to cancel a picnic. We cooked together indoors instead.
Q3: I check the forecast if I am traveling across town. On ordinary days, I just look outside and take an umbrella if the sky looks dark.
tips_md:
**IELTS Part 1 – thời tiết:**
- Kết hợp tính từ cụ thể **cool**, **cloudy**, **humid** với ảnh hưởng đến việc học hay làm việc.
- Ở câu 2, kể tình huống ngắn theo trình tự **kế hoạch → thời tiết → cách thay thế**.
- Câu 3 trả lời theo điều kiện **if I am traveling...** để tránh khẳng định quá tuyệt đối.
- Chú ý thì quá khứ trong chuyện đã xảy ra và hiện tại đơn khi nói thói quen.

title: IELTS Part 1: Learning by Doing
prompt:
IELTS Speaking Part 1. Discuss practical learning.
1. Do you like learning things by trying them yourself?
2. What practical skill have you learned recently?
3. Who do you ask for help when you cannot solve a problem?
sample_answer:
Q1: Yes. Instructions make more sense to me after I have tried a task once, even if I make a few mistakes.
Q2: I recently learned to sew a loose button onto a shirt. It is simple, but it means I can repair my clothes instead of replacing them.
Q3: I usually ask a friend who has done something similar. I explain what I have already tried so they do not have to start from the beginning.
tips_md:
**IELTS Part 1 – học qua thực hành:**
- Câu 1 khẳng định sở thích rồi bổ sung **even if...** để diễn đạt thái độ trước sai sót.
- Câu 2 chọn kỹ năng nhỏ và nói kết quả hữu ích; ví dụ bình thường vẫn có sức thuyết phục.
- Câu 3 giải thích cách xin trợ giúp, có thể dùng **what I have already tried**.
- Giữ ngữ điệu hội thoại, tránh biến Part 1 thành bài diễn thuyết dài.

title: IELTS Part 1: Borrowing and Lending
prompt:
IELTS Speaking Part 1. Answer questions about sharing possessions.
1. What is something you sometimes borrow from other people?
2. Do you find it easy to lend your belongings to friends?
3. Have borrowing habits changed because of technology?
sample_answer:
Q1: I sometimes borrow cookbooks from a neighbor. She enjoys trying new recipes and always has interesting suggestions.
Q2: Usually, yes, especially if someone explains when they will return the item. I am more careful with things that are difficult to replace.
Q3: I think so. People can lend digital books or share tools through neighborhood groups, which makes it easier to find what they need.
tips_md:
**IELTS Part 1 – mượn và cho mượn:**
- Phân biệt **borrow something from someone** và **lend something to someone**.
- Với câu 2, đặt một điều kiện hợp lý để câu trả lời có chiều sâu, ví dụ thời hạn hoàn trả.
- Câu 3 dùng **I think** để thể hiện quan điểm và một ví dụ về cách công nghệ hỗ trợ chia sẻ.
- Tránh lạm dụng từ **share** khi ý muốn nói là mượn tạm một vật.

title: IELTS Part 1: Waiting for Transport
prompt:
IELTS Speaking Part 1. Talk about buses, trains and waiting.
1. Where do you usually wait for public transport?
2. What do you do while waiting?
3. What would make a bus or train stop more comfortable?
sample_answer:
Q1: I usually wait at a bus shelter near the post office. It is close enough to reach on foot.
Q2: I check the arrival information and sometimes listen to a short podcast. I keep the volume low so I can hear announcements.
Q3: Better shade would make a real difference in summer. A clear display showing delays would also help people decide whether to wait or take another route.
tips_md:
**IELTS Part 1 – trạm giao thông:**
- Nêu vị trí cụ thể nhưng đơn giản, rồi giải thích lý do thuận tiện.
- Câu 2 kể hai hoạt động và cách chúng phù hợp với bối cảnh chờ xe.
- Câu 3 dùng cấu trúc giả định **would make...**, ưu tiên hai cải tiến rõ ràng có lợi ích đi kèm.
- Luyện nhấn **arrival information**, **shade**, **delays** để làm nổi bật ý chính.

title: IELTS Part 2: A Repair You Learned to Do
prompt:
IELTS Speaking Part 2 cue card. Describe something you learned to repair. You should say:
- what the item was
- why it needed repairing
- how you learned to fix it
- and explain how you felt after the repair.
You have one minute to prepare and up to two minutes to speak.
sample_answer: I'd like to talk about an old desk lamp that stopped working during exam season. At first, I thought the whole lamp was broken, but the light flickered whenever I moved the cable. I asked my uncle to take a look because he has repaired small household items for years. He helped me unplug the lamp, examine the plug and check whether the cable had been damaged. We discovered that the removable power adapter was faulty. He showed me how to match the voltage and connector before buying a compatible replacement. Once we connected it, the lamp worked normally again. What I remember most is the feeling of relief. I could study comfortably that evening, and I had learned to investigate a problem instead of immediately throwing something away. Since then, I have become more willing to maintain simple items, although I still leave dangerous electrical repairs to a qualified person.
tips_md:
**IELTS Part 2 – kể một lần sửa đồ:**
- Trong 60 giây, ghi bốn từ khóa **item → problem → solution → feeling**, không viết nguyên câu.
- Kể theo quá khứ với **stopped working**, **discovered**, **replaced**; thêm một chi tiết kỹ thuật dễ hiểu.
- Dùng **at first**, **once**, **since then** để chuyển mốc thời gian tự nhiên.
- Dành 20 giây cuối cho cảm xúc và bài học, tránh kết thúc ngay sau thao tác sửa.

title: IELTS Part 2: A Day Without Your Phone
prompt:
IELTS Speaking Part 2 cue card. Describe a day when you used your phone much less than usual. You should say:
- when and where it happened
- why you used your phone less
- what you did instead
- and explain whether you would repeat the experience.
sample_answer: Last autumn, I spent a Saturday at a lakeside campsite with three friends. We agreed to keep our phones in our bags unless we needed them for an emergency. One friend had noticed that we were always checking messages, even when we were together. Without constant notifications, the morning felt surprisingly long. We cooked breakfast slowly, followed a short walking trail and tried to identify birds by their calls. In the afternoon, we played a card game and talked about the books we had enjoyed as children. I did feel uncomfortable at first because I wanted to photograph everything. Later, I realized I could remember the day without recording every moment. We still checked the weather and called home before leaving, so it was not a complete digital blackout. I would happily repeat the experience once a month. It reminded me that being available online all the time is a habit I can occasionally put aside.
tips_md:
**IELTS Part 2 – trải nghiệm ít dùng điện thoại:**
- Chuẩn bị một bối cảnh cụ thể, ba hoạt động thay thế và hai cảm xúc đối lập.
- Dùng **at first / later / by the end of the day** để thể hiện thay đổi suy nghĩ.
- Phân biệt **used my phone less** với **didn't use it at all** để tránh tự mâu thuẫn.
- Kết thúc bằng việc bạn có muốn lặp lại trải nghiệm hay không và một lý do cá nhân.

title: IELTS Part 2: A Question That Helped You
prompt:
IELTS Speaking Part 2 cue card. Describe a useful question someone asked you. You should say:
- who asked the question
- what situation you were in
- what the question was
- and explain how it changed what you did next.
sample_answer: The most useful question I remember came from a teacher during a group project. Our team was preparing a presentation about reducing waste at school. We had collected lots of statistics, but the slides were becoming crowded and hard to follow. After listening to our rehearsal, the teacher asked, 'What is the one action you want your audience to take tomorrow?' That simple question made us realize we had not chosen a clear message. We spent the next afternoon reorganizing the presentation around one practical suggestion: placing clearly labeled collection boxes near classroom doors. We kept only the numbers that supported that recommendation and replaced long paragraphs with photographs of the proposed locations. The final presentation was much easier to understand, and several classmates volunteered to help. I still think about that question when I start a new assignment. Before gathering more information, I try to decide what outcome I am actually working toward.
tips_md:
**IELTS Part 2 – câu hỏi có ích:**
- Trả lời rõ **ai hỏi, lúc nào, nguyên văn hoặc ý chính câu hỏi, tác động**.
- Dùng lời dẫn ngắn trước câu hỏi trích dẫn để người nghe nắm bối cảnh.
- Phần quan trọng là sự thay đổi **before / after**; nêu hành động cụ thể thay vì chỉ nói *it helped*.
- Có thể dùng **made us realize**, **as a result**, **ever since** để tạo mạch nhân quả.

title: IELTS Part 2: A Surprisingly Quiet Place
prompt:
IELTS Speaking Part 2 cue card. Describe a public place that was quieter than you expected. You should say:
- where the place was
- why you visited it
- what made it peaceful
- and explain why you remember it.
sample_answer: I once found a remarkably quiet courtyard behind a busy railway station. I had arrived early to meet a relative and wanted somewhere to sit while I waited. The main entrance was crowded, so I followed a sign pointing toward a small public garden beside the station library. The courtyard had a few wooden benches, tall trees and a shallow fountain. Although buses were passing on the other side of the building, I could barely hear them. A man was reading a newspaper, and two students were sketching the plants. Nobody seemed in a hurry. I bought a bottle of water and spent nearly forty minutes reading there. What surprised me was the contrast between the noisy transport hub and this peaceful space only a short walk away. I have returned a few times since then, especially when I need to collect my thoughts. It showed me that a crowded city can still offer small pockets of calm.
tips_md:
**IELTS Part 2 – không gian yên tĩnh:**
- Vẽ nhanh bố cục trong đầu với **location, sounds, people, feelings**.
- Sử dụng **although**, **in contrast**, **only a short walk away** để làm nổi bật điều bất ngờ.
- Tả bằng giác quan như tiếng nước, bóng cây, mức độ ồn thay vì lặp **quiet** nhiều lần.
- Chốt bằng lý do nơi này đáng nhớ hoặc khi nào bạn quay lại.

title: IELTS Part 2: A Small Celebration
prompt:
IELTS Speaking Part 2 cue card. Describe a small celebration that meant a lot to you. You should say:
- what was being celebrated
- who was there
- what you did together
- and explain why the occasion was meaningful.
sample_answer: A celebration I remember fondly was the evening my sister completed her first long-distance cycling event. She had trained on weekends for several months, often getting up before sunrise. When she finished, she said she was too tired for a big party, so our family organized a simple dinner at home. We made her favorite noodle dish, put a few paper decorations around the table and invited two friends who had trained with her. My father gave a short toast about persistence, while my sister showed us the route on a map and laughed about getting lost near the finish line. There were no expensive gifts. We just listened to her stories and enjoyed being together. I think the evening mattered because we celebrated the effort behind her achievement, not only the result. It also encouraged me to keep working on my own goals, even when progress is slow and difficult to notice.
tips_md:
**IELTS Part 2 – buổi ăn mừng nhỏ:**
- Chọn một dịp có ý nghĩa riêng, không cần sự kiện hoành tráng.
- Kể ba hành động theo trình tự **prepared → gathered → shared**, thêm một chi tiết đáng nhớ.
- Dùng **had trained** để nhắc nỗ lực xảy ra trước buổi tiệc và **encouraged me** cho ảnh hưởng sau đó.
- Phần giải thích ý nghĩa nên dài ít nhất 20–30 giây cuối.

title: IELTS Part 2: A Skill Learned from an Older Person
prompt:
IELTS Speaking Part 2 cue card. Describe a skill you learned from an older person. You should say:
- who taught you
- what the skill was
- how you practiced it
- and explain why the skill is still useful.
sample_answer: My neighbor taught me how to sharpen kitchen knives safely using a simple sharpening stone. She used to run a small food stall, so she knew how important well-maintained tools were. One afternoon, she noticed that I was struggling to cut vegetables with a dull knife and offered to demonstrate. First, she explained how to stabilize the stone and keep my fingers away from the blade. Then she showed me how to maintain a steady angle and move the knife slowly across the surface. I practiced with her guidance and checked the result on a tomato. It took several attempts, and she kept reminding me that control was more important than speed. I now look after my kitchen tools instead of waiting until they become difficult to use. More importantly, I learned to appreciate the practical knowledge people gain through years of everyday work. Her patient teaching made a routine household task feel surprisingly satisfying.
tips_md:
**IELTS Part 2 – kỹ năng học từ người lớn tuổi:**
- Nêu mối quan hệ và kinh nghiệm của người hướng dẫn để tạo bối cảnh.
- Trình bày các bước bằng **first**, **then**, **after several attempts**; chỉ chọn chi tiết an toàn, dễ giải thích.
- So sánh **lúc chưa biết làm** với **hiện tại tự làm được**.
- Kết luận về giá trị của việc học giữa các thế hệ thay vì chỉ nhắc lại tên kỹ năng.

title: IELTS Part 3: Repairing Instead of Replacing
prompt: IELTS Speaking Part 3 discussion. Why do people often replace products instead of repairing them? What could governments and manufacturers do to make repairs more common? Develop your answer with examples.
sample_answer: Many people replace products because repairs can be inconvenient. A technician may be difficult to find, and a replacement part can cost almost as much as a new device. Advertising also encourages people to associate newer products with better performance. I think manufacturers should publish clear repair instructions and make common parts available for a reasonable period. Governments could support independent repair shops through training programs or consumer information. For example, a town might create a directory of reliable repair services and organize occasional workshops for simple household items. Of course, safety matters, particularly with electrical equipment, so some repairs should be left to professionals. Overall, making products easier to maintain would save money for households and reduce unnecessary waste.
tips_md:
**IELTS Part 3 – sửa chữa và tiêu dùng:**
- Câu hỏi **why** cần ít nhất hai nguyên nhân khác nhau như chi phí và sự tiện lợi.
- Sau đó chuyển sang giải pháp ở hai cấp **manufacturers / governments**, mỗi cấp một hành động cụ thể.
- Dùng **for example** và **of course** để thêm minh họa và giới hạn hợp lý.
- Giữ giọng phân tích, tránh khẳng định mọi sản phẩm đều sửa được.

title: IELTS Part 3: Should People Schedule Digital Breaks?
prompt: IELTS Speaking Part 3 discussion. Why is it difficult for some people to disconnect from their devices? Should schools and employers encourage regular screen-free breaks? Explain your views.
sample_answer: It can be difficult to disconnect because phones combine work, entertainment and social contact in one place. People may worry about missing an important message, especially if their workplace expects quick replies. I think schools and employers should encourage short breaks, but they should explain the purpose rather than impose complicated rules. For instance, a school could offer outdoor activities during lunch, while an office could protect a ten-minute break between long video meetings. These changes would give people a chance to rest their eyes and talk face to face. At the same time, some workers must remain reachable in emergencies, so teams need clear arrangements. In my view, the goal is to make people more deliberate about screen use rather than to treat every minute online as harmful.
tips_md:
**IELTS Part 3 – nghỉ khỏi màn hình:**
- Phân tích nguyên nhân xã hội và công việc thay vì chỉ nói người dùng thiếu kỷ luật.
- Đưa ví dụ riêng cho **schools** và **employers** theo đúng hai nhóm của đề.
- Cân bằng lập luận bằng **at the same time** rồi giải thích trường hợp cần giữ liên lạc.
- Dùng cụm **be reachable**, **face to face**, **deliberate about** một cách tự nhiên.

title: IELTS Part 3: Encouraging Better Questions
prompt: IELTS Speaking Part 3 discussion. Why are some students reluctant to ask questions in class? How can teachers create an environment where questions lead to deeper learning?
sample_answer: Some students are reluctant to ask questions because they fear looking unprepared in front of classmates. Others have learned in previous classes that asking questions can interrupt the lesson or attract criticism. Teachers can change this by showing that uncertainty is a normal part of learning. For example, they could invite students to write anonymous questions at the end of a topic, then discuss a few without naming anyone. They could also respond positively when a student identifies a gap in an explanation. I think group discussions are helpful because students often feel more comfortable testing an idea with two or three peers first. The quality of a classroom conversation improves when asking for clarification is treated as a skill to develop, rather than a sign of weakness.
tips_md:
**IELTS Part 3 – đặt câu hỏi trong lớp:**
- Tách nguyên nhân tâm lý **fear of embarrassment** và nguyên nhân về môi trường học.
- Mỗi giải pháp cần có cơ chế: câu hỏi ẩn danh giảm ngại ngùng, thảo luận nhóm tăng tự tin.
- Dùng **could** cho gợi ý và **because** để nêu tác dụng.
- Kết bằng nguyên tắc giáo dục rộng hơn, không chuyển sang kể chuyện cá nhân quá dài.

title: IELTS Part 3: Finding Quiet in Busy Cities
prompt: IELTS Speaking Part 3 discussion. What are the main sources of noise in cities? Who should be responsible for creating quiet public spaces, and why?
sample_answer: Traffic is probably the most obvious source of urban noise, but construction sites and crowded entertainment areas can also affect nearby residents. The problem is especially serious for people who work night shifts or study at home. I believe local authorities should take the lead because they control planning decisions and public facilities. They could create parks away from major roads, require reasonable construction hours and preserve quiet areas in public libraries. Businesses and residents still have responsibilities, of course. A café owner can manage outdoor music, while residents can report repeated disturbances respectfully. For example, even a small courtyard with trees and benches can provide relief if it is designed carefully. Quiet space should be considered part of a healthy city, alongside transport and housing.
tips_md:
**IELTS Part 3 – tiếng ồn đô thị:**
- Nêu hai hoặc ba nguồn tiếng ồn kèm đối tượng chịu ảnh hưởng.
- Trả lời thẳng **who should be responsible**, rồi phân vai chính quyền, doanh nghiệp và người dân.
- Dùng **could require**, **can manage**, **should be considered** để thể hiện cấp độ trách nhiệm.
- Tránh khẳng định cây xanh tự động loại bỏ mọi tiếng ồn; ví dụ chỉ cần hợp lý.

title: IELTS Part 3: The Future of Local Celebrations
prompt: IELTS Speaking Part 3 discussion. How can small local festivals strengthen a community? Are there disadvantages when a local celebration becomes a major tourist attraction?
sample_answer: Small festivals give neighbors a reason to work together on something enjoyable. Volunteers may prepare food, decorate public spaces or teach children traditional games, so people meet others they would not normally talk to. They can also help local craftspeople earn money. However, when a celebration attracts very large crowds, the organizers may begin designing everything for visitors. Prices can rise, familiar activities may be replaced by commercial displays, and residents may struggle with traffic and litter. I think the solution is to involve local people in planning and limit the number of large stalls where space is tight. For example, a festival could reserve certain activities for community groups while providing separate areas for tourists. That would allow the event to grow without losing its original character.
tips_md:
**IELTS Part 3 – lễ hội cộng đồng:**
- Phần lợi ích dùng chuỗi **hoạt động chung → gặp gỡ → gắn kết**.
- Phần hạn chế đề cập một hệ quả xã hội hoặc kinh tế cụ thể, tránh phản đối du lịch chung chung.
- Dùng từ nối **however**, **for example**, **that would allow** để chuyển từ vấn đề sang giải pháp.
- Tập các cụm **local craftspeople**, **commercial displays**, **original character**.

title: IELTS Part 3: Learning Across Generations
prompt: IELTS Speaking Part 3 discussion. What can younger and older people learn from one another? Should community centers organize more activities that bring different age groups together?
sample_answer: Different generations often have complementary knowledge. Older people may have practical experience with cooking, household repairs or handling difficult conversations, while younger people may be familiar with new digital services. Sharing these skills can make both groups feel more confident. I would support community programs that bring them together, provided the activities are based on mutual interests rather than stereotypes. A center could organize a photography workshop where younger participants explain phone editing tools and older participants share techniques for composing an image. Everyone would have something valuable to contribute. Such programs also create informal conversations between people who might otherwise live quite separate lives. In my opinion, the greatest benefit may be reducing the assumption that age determines what someone can teach or learn.
tips_md:
**IELTS Part 3 – học giữa các thế hệ:**
- Trình bày kỹ năng của hai nhóm bằng cấu trúc cân đối **older people may... while younger people may...**.
- Nêu rõ lý do ủng hộ hoạt động cộng đồng rồi đưa ví dụ có **trao đổi hai chiều**.
- Tránh nói tuyệt đối rằng người lớn tuổi không biết công nghệ hoặc người trẻ thiếu kinh nghiệm.
- Chốt bằng lợi ích xã hội lâu dài, chẳng hạn giảm định kiến về tuổi tác.

title: TOEIC Read Aloud: Hotel Laundry Collection
prompt: Good evening, guests. Our hotel offers laundry collection every morning from eight until ten. Please place your clothing in the reusable bag provided in your room and complete the attached service form. Standard orders will be returned by six the following evening. If you need an item sooner, contact the front desk before nine in the morning to ask about express service. We appreciate your cooperation and hope you enjoy your stay.
sample_answer: Good evening, guests. / Our hotel offers laundry collection / every morning from eight until ten. / Please place your clothing / in the reusable bag provided in your room / and complete the attached service form. / Standard orders will be returned / by six the following evening. / If you need an item sooner, / contact the front desk before nine in the morning / to ask about express service. / We appreciate your cooperation / and hope you enjoy your stay.
tips_md:
**TOEIC Read Aloud – dịch vụ khách sạn:**
- Đánh dấu ba mốc giờ **eight until ten**, **by six**, **before nine** để không nhầm thời gian nhận, trả và yêu cầu nhanh.
- Ngắt hơi sau lời chào và trước mệnh đề điều kiện **If you need...**.
- Nhấn từ nội dung **collection**, **reusable bag**, **service form**, **express service**; giữ âm cuối của **guests**, **orders**.
- Đọc như nhân viên hướng dẫn khách: thân thiện, rõ ràng, tốc độ ổn định trong 45 giây.

title: TOEIC Read Aloud: Visitor Badge Procedure
prompt: Welcome to the Northpoint Business Center. All visitors must sign in at the ground-floor reception desk and wear a temporary badge while inside the building. Please keep your badge visible during meetings and return it before leaving. Guests attending events on the fifth floor should use the elevators beside the information counter. If you have trouble finding your meeting room, our reception team will be happy to assist you.
sample_answer: Welcome to the Northpoint Business Center. / All visitors must sign in / at the ground-floor reception desk / and wear a temporary badge / while inside the building. / Please keep your badge visible during meetings / and return it before leaving. / Guests attending events on the fifth floor / should use the elevators beside the information counter. / If you have trouble finding your meeting room, / our reception team will be happy to assist you.
tips_md:
**TOEIC Read Aloud – hướng dẫn khách vào tòa nhà:**
- Tách quy trình thành **sign in → wear a badge → return it**, nhấn rõ động từ.
- Luyện trọng âm **temporary**, **reception**, **elevators** và đọc rõ âm cuối trong **guests**.
- Chú ý chỉ dẫn vị trí **ground-floor**, **fifth floor**, **beside the information counter**.
- Hạ giọng ở câu mệnh lệnh lịch sự, giữ ngữ điệu hỗ trợ ở câu cuối.

title: TOEIC Read Aloud: Parcel Locker Service Update
prompt: Beginning next Tuesday, customers may collect online orders from the new parcel lockers beside the west parking entrance. When your package is ready, you will receive a message containing a six-digit collection code. Enter the code on the touchscreen, then take your parcel from the unlocked compartment. Orders must be collected within three days. For assistance with a damaged locker or an expired code, please contact the customer service counter during regular business hours.
sample_answer: Beginning next Tuesday, / customers may collect online orders / from the new parcel lockers / beside the west parking entrance. / When your package is ready, / you will receive a message / containing a six-digit collection code. / Enter the code on the touchscreen, / then take your parcel / from the unlocked compartment. / Orders must be collected within three days. / For assistance with a damaged locker or an expired code, / please contact the customer service counter / during regular business hours.
tips_md:
**TOEIC Read Aloud – nhận hàng tại tủ khóa:**
- Nhấn **next Tuesday**, **six-digit code**, **within three days** là thông tin quan trọng nhất.
- Chia thao tác thành nhịp **receive a message → enter the code → take the parcel**.
- Tập từ ghép **touchscreen**, **compartment**, **customer service** và âm cuối **orders**.
- Dừng nhẹ trước câu về thời hạn để người nghe nhận ra quy định cần nhớ.

title: TOEIC Picture: Arranging a Store Window
prompt: TOEIC Speaking picture description. Describe the setting, the people, and the visible actions. Avoid guessing details that cannot be seen.
image_description: Inside a clothing shop, two employees are preparing a window display. On the left, an employee wearing a dark apron stands on a small step stool and adjusts a jacket on a mannequin. Another employee kneels beside a low display table and folds a stack of colorful scarves. A row of shoes is neatly arranged on shelves behind them. The large front window shows a pedestrian street outside, and a handwritten sale sign rests against the glass.
sample_answer: The picture shows two employees setting up a display in a clothing store. On the left, one person is standing on a step stool and adjusting a jacket on a mannequin. The other employee is kneeling beside a table and folding scarves. Several pairs of shoes are arranged on shelves behind them. There is also a sale sign near the large window, which looks out onto a pedestrian street.
tips_md:
**TOEIC Describe Picture – cửa hàng quần áo:**
- Mở bằng **two employees setting up a display**, rồi đi từ trái sang phải.
- Dùng **is standing**, **is adjusting**, **is kneeling**, **is folding** cho hành động đang diễn ra.
- Đồ vật dùng **mannequin**, **step stool**, **scarves**, **shelves**; nếu quên từ, diễn đạt bằng từ thông dụng.
- Dành khoảng 20 giây cho hành động chính và 10 giây cho vị trí, nền ảnh.

title: TOEIC Picture: Preparing Conference Name Tags
prompt: TOEIC Speaking picture description. Explain what is visible in this event preparation scene.
image_description: In a hotel foyer, three event staff members stand behind a registration counter. A woman in the middle is placing printed name tags into clear plastic holders. A man on her right is arranging lanyards into neat bundles, while another staff member is checking names on a tablet. Two small signs marked 'Speakers' and 'Guests' stand on the counter. In the background, several rows of empty chairs and a closed conference-room door are visible.
sample_answer: This picture was taken at a conference registration desk. Three staff members are getting ready for an event. The woman in the middle is putting name tags into plastic holders. On the right, a man is arranging lanyards, and another person is looking at a tablet. There are signs for speakers and guests on the counter. In the background, I can see empty chairs and a conference-room door.
tips_md:
**TOEIC Describe Picture – bàn đăng ký hội nghị:**
- Nêu bối cảnh **registration desk** trước khi mô tả từng nhân viên.
- Dùng vị trí **in the middle**, **on the right**, **in the background** để tránh nhầm hành động.
- Luyện **name tags**, **lanyards**, **plastic holders**, **tablet**, đặc biệt số nhiều của **tags**.
- Không đoán tên hội nghị hay chức vụ cụ thể khi ảnh không thể hiện.

title: TOEIC Picture: Receiving Restaurant Supplies
prompt: TOEIC Speaking picture description. Describe the people, objects, and actions at the restaurant entrance.
image_description: Outside the back entrance of a restaurant, a delivery worker in a blue uniform is moving a hand truck stacked with sealed cardboard boxes. A restaurant employee in a white apron stands beside the door and checks a paper delivery list on a clipboard. Two empty plastic crates are on the ground near the wall. Through the open door, metal shelves and a stainless-steel preparation table can be seen. The pavement is dry and the area is shaded.
sample_answer: The image shows a delivery taking place outside a restaurant. A worker in a blue uniform is pushing a hand truck carrying several cardboard boxes. Near the doorway, an employee in a white apron is checking a list on a clipboard. Two empty crates are on the ground. Inside the restaurant, I can see metal shelves and a large preparation table. The two people appear to be checking a supply delivery.
tips_md:
**TOEIC Describe Picture – giao hàng:**
- Bắt đầu bằng **a delivery outside a restaurant**, rồi nêu hai hành động độc lập.
- Các động từ mạnh là **is pushing**, **is carrying**, **is checking**.
- Dùng **outside / near the doorway / inside** để mô tả các lớp không gian.
- Chỉ nói **appear to be checking** nếu cần suy luận nhẹ; không tự thêm loại thực phẩm trong hộp kín.

title: TOEIC Picture: Working in a Print Shop
prompt: TOEIC Speaking picture description. Describe the equipment and actions you can observe.
image_description: In a small print shop, a staff member wearing a green sweater is standing beside a large printer and inspecting a freshly printed poster. Another worker sits at a nearby desk, using a laptop next to a stack of paper samples. Several colorful sample posters hang on the wall, and a paper cutter rests on a side table. The floor is clear, and boxes of unused paper are stacked neatly under a shelf.
sample_answer: This photo shows two people working in a print shop. One employee is standing next to a large printer and looking carefully at a poster. Another person is sitting at a desk and using a laptop. Some printed samples are lying on the desk, and several posters are hanging on the wall. There is also a paper cutter on a table and a few boxes under a shelf.
tips_md:
**TOEIC Describe Picture – xưởng in:**
- Ưu tiên người và hành động trước: **inspecting a poster**, **using a laptop**.
- Phân biệt **printer** (máy in), **paper cutter** (dao/máy cắt giấy), **samples** (mẫu).
- Thêm hai chi tiết không gian bằng **next to**, **on the wall**, **under a shelf**.
- Tránh nói đơn hàng đang lỗi hay khách hàng đang chờ vì ảnh không chứng minh được.

title: TOEIC Questions: Listening During Your Commute
prompt:
A transportation magazine is conducting a survey about audio habits during commutes.
Question 1: How do you usually travel to work or school?
Question 2: Do you listen to anything while traveling?
Question 3: What would make your daily journey more pleasant?
sample_answer:
Q1: I usually take the train, and the journey takes around twenty-five minutes.
Q2: Yes, I often listen to short interviews on my headphones. They make the trip feel quicker.
Q3: More accurate arrival announcements would improve the experience. Sometimes I do not know whether a train is delayed, so I keep checking my phone. Clear information would help me plan my time, and a few more seats at the station would make waiting more comfortable.
tips_md:
**TOEIC Respond to Questions – đi lại:**
- Dành khoảng **15 giây** cho mỗi câu đầu và **30 giây** cho câu cuối.
- Câu 1 trả lời phương tiện + thời gian đi, câu 2 thêm loại nội dung nghe và tác dụng.
- Câu 3 nêu **vấn đề → giải pháp → lợi ích**, tránh chỉ liệt kê tiện ích.
- Nói rõ từ **arrival announcements**, **delayed**, **comfortable**; đừng lan man về giao thông toàn thành phố.

title: TOEIC Questions: Lunch Breaks at Work
prompt:
An office manager is surveying employees about lunch breaks.
Question 1: What time do you normally have lunch?
Question 2: Do you usually eat alone or with colleagues?
Question 3: What could the company do to make lunch breaks more enjoyable?
sample_answer:
Q1: I usually eat lunch at about twelve thirty, after finishing my morning tasks.
Q2: I often eat with two colleagues because we work on the same floor.
Q3: It would be helpful to have a quiet lunch area with enough tables and drinking water. Our current break room gets crowded, so people sometimes eat at their desks. A more comfortable space could encourage us to take proper breaks and return to work feeling refreshed.
tips_md:
**TOEIC Respond to Questions – giờ nghỉ trưa:**
- Dùng thì hiện tại đơn để nói thói quen: **usually eat**, **often eat with**.
- Câu 3 tránh yêu cầu mơ hồ như **make it better**; chọn cải tiến có thể thực hiện.
- Dùng **current problem → proposed change → expected result** để phát triển đủ 30 giây.
- Giữ tốc độ tự nhiên, phát âm rõ **colleagues**, **crowded**, **refreshed**.

title: TOEIC Questions: Giving Customer Feedback
prompt:
A service company is asking customers how they share feedback.
Question 1: When did you last contact a company's customer service team?
Question 2: Which do you prefer, email or live chat, and why?
Question 3: Describe what makes a customer service response particularly helpful.
sample_answer:
Q1: I contacted a delivery company last week because I needed to change an address.
Q2: I prefer live chat for simple questions because I can get an answer while I am at my computer.
Q3: A helpful response explains the next step clearly and gives a realistic time frame. For example, when I asked about my parcel, the agent checked the order number, confirmed the new address and told me when the change would appear in the tracking system. That saved me from contacting them again.
tips_md:
**TOEIC Respond to Questions – dịch vụ khách hàng:**
- Câu 1 cần mốc thời gian và lý do liên hệ bằng quá khứ đơn.
- Câu 2 chọn một kênh liên lạc và nêu lợi thế thực tế.
- Câu 3 bổ sung ví dụ theo thứ tự **agent checked → confirmed → explained**.
- Luyện **realistic time frame**, **tracking system**, **confirmed**, chú ý trọng âm và âm cuối.

title: TOEIC Information: Training Room Schedule
prompt:
Read the schedule for 45 seconds, then answer three questions from a colleague.

**Hawthorne Training Center — Thursday**

| Session | Time | Room |
|---|---|---|
| Spreadsheet Basics | 9:00–10:00 A.M. | Maple |
| Writing Clear Emails | 10:30–11:30 A.M. | Cedar |
| Presentation Practice | 1:00–2:30 P.M. | Maple |
| Workplace Safety | 3:00–4:00 P.M. | Birch |

Questions:
1. What time does the email-writing session begin?
2. Which room is used for the presentation workshop?
3. I am free after two thirty in the afternoon. Which session could I attend, and where is it held?
sample_answer:
Q1: The Writing Clear Emails session begins at ten thirty in the morning.
Q2: Presentation Practice takes place in the Maple Room, from one until two thirty.
Q3: You could attend Workplace Safety. It starts at three o'clock and finishes at four, so it fits your availability. The session is in the Birch Room.
tips_md:
**TOEIC Respond to Information – lịch đào tạo:**
- Trong 45 giây chuẩn bị, khoanh **session / time / room** và nhớ hàng có lịch buổi chiều.
- Câu 1 cần giờ **10:30**, câu 2 cần phòng **Maple**; có thể thêm giờ nhưng phải chính xác.
- Ở câu 3, đối chiếu điều kiện **after 2:30** với giờ bắt đầu **3:00**, nêu phòng **Birch**.
- Tránh nhầm **Cedar** (email) với **Maple** (thuyết trình).

title: TOEIC Information: Borrowing Event Equipment
prompt:
Read the equipment loan list for 45 seconds, then answer three requests.

**Rivergate Events Office — Friday Collection**

| Equipment | Available Units | Return Deadline |
|---|---:|---|
| Portable projector | 2 | Monday, 10:00 A.M. |
| Wireless microphone | 0 | Monday, noon |
| Folding display board | 5 | Tuesday, 4:00 P.M. |
| Extension cable | 8 | Tuesday, 4:00 P.M. |

Collection desk: Lobby C, open 8:30–11:30 A.M.

Questions:
1. Where and when can I collect equipment on Friday?
2. Can I borrow a wireless microphone?
3. We need three display boards. Are there enough available, and when must we return them?
sample_answer:
Q1: You can collect equipment at the desk in Lobby C between eight thirty and eleven thirty on Friday morning.
Q2: I'm afraid wireless microphones are currently unavailable. There are no units left to borrow.
Q3: Yes, there are five folding display boards available, so you can borrow three. They must be returned by four in the afternoon on Tuesday.
tips_md:
**TOEIC Respond to Information – mượn thiết bị:**
- Đừng nhầm **Available Units** (số lượng) và **Return Deadline** (hạn trả).
- Câu 2 số **0** phải diễn đạt **currently unavailable**, không tự đề xuất giờ có hàng.
- Câu 3 so sánh nhu cầu **three** với lượng còn **five**, sau đó đọc đầy đủ **Tuesday, 4:00 P.M.**.
- Dùng ngữ điệu lịch sự khi thông báo không còn thiết bị.

title: TOEIC Information: Hotel Shuttle Departures
prompt:
Study the shuttle timetable for 45 seconds, then answer three guest questions.

**Lakeshore Hotel — Complimentary Shuttle**

| Departure | Destination | Travel Time |
|---|---|---|
| 7:15 A.M. | Central Station | 20 minutes |
| 9:00 A.M. | Art Museum | 15 minutes |
| 12:30 P.M. | Central Station | 20 minutes |
| 5:45 P.M. | Harbor Market | 25 minutes |

All shuttles leave from the hotel's south entrance. Reservations close 30 minutes before departure.

Questions:
1. Where does the shuttle leave from?
2. How long does the nine o'clock shuttle take, and where does it go?
3. I want the evening shuttle to Harbor Market. When does it leave, and what is the latest time I can reserve a seat?
sample_answer:
Q1: All shuttle buses depart from the south entrance of the hotel.
Q2: The nine o'clock shuttle goes to the Art Museum, and the journey takes fifteen minutes.
Q3: The evening shuttle to Harbor Market departs at five forty-five. Because reservations close thirty minutes before departure, you should book your seat by five fifteen in the afternoon.
tips_md:
**TOEIC Respond to Information – xe đưa đón:**
- Phân biệt **departure** là giờ xe rời khách sạn và **travel time** là thời gian di chuyển.
- Câu 2 ghép đúng hàng **9:00 → Art Museum → 15 minutes**.
- Câu 3 tính **5:45 trừ 30 phút = 5:15 P.M.** và nói rõ đây là hạn đặt chỗ.
- Luyện cách nói giờ **five forty-five** và **five fifteen**, tránh đọc số thiếu đơn vị.

title: TOEIC Opinion: A Company Volunteer Day
prompt: Some employers give staff one paid day each year to volunteer for a local organization. Do you think this is a worthwhile benefit? Give reasons and an example.
sample_answer: I think a paid volunteer day is a worthwhile benefit. First, it gives employees an opportunity to help their community without losing income or using personal vacation time. Second, volunteering with colleagues can improve relationships across departments. For example, a company could organize a morning when staff help a food bank sort donated supplies. People from different teams would work toward a shared goal and learn more about local needs. The program should offer several activities so employees can choose something suitable. Overall, I believe one volunteer day could make the workplace more connected and help organizations that need extra support.
tips_md:
**TOEIC Express an Opinion – ngày tình nguyện:**
- Chọn quan điểm ngay câu đầu bằng **I think... is worthwhile**.
- Triển khai hai lý do khác nhau **community impact** và **team relationships**.
- Ví dụ cần có **hoạt động cụ thể, người tham gia, kết quả**, không chỉ nói làm từ thiện.
- Giữ bố cục 10 giây mở ý, 40 giây giải thích và ví dụ, 10 giây kết luận.

title: TOEIC Opinion: Digital or Printed Work Instructions
prompt: A company plans to replace printed instruction manuals with a searchable digital library. Do you support this change? Explain with reasons and a workplace example.
sample_answer: I support moving most work instructions to a searchable digital library. Employees could find updated procedures quickly instead of looking through old binders. It would also be easier for managers to correct information in one place. For example, when a customer service policy changes, the team could update the relevant page and notify staff immediately. However, the company should provide a few printed emergency instructions in areas where internet access might fail. That would make the change more practical. In general, digital manuals would save time and reduce paper use, as long as employees receive a short introduction to the new system.
tips_md:
**TOEIC Express an Opinion – sổ tay điện tử:**
- Nêu quan điểm **support** hoặc **oppose** rồi giải thích bằng lợi ích vận hành cụ thể.
- Dùng ví dụ về tài liệu được cập nhật để chứng minh **searchable** và **up-to-date** hữu ích ra sao.
- Một nhượng bộ ngắn bằng **however** giúp câu trả lời thực tế hơn, nhưng không đổi quan điểm giữa bài.
- Kết luận quay về thời gian tiết kiệm và điều kiện triển khai hợp lý.

title: VSTEP Part 1: Working from Different Locations
prompt:
VSTEP Speaking Part 1, social interaction. Answer three questions about your working or study routine.
1. Where do you usually do your most important work or studying?
2. What do you find difficult about working or studying from home?
3. Would you prefer a fixed schedule or a flexible one in the future?
sample_answer:
Q1: I usually do my most demanding tasks at a desk in my room. It is quiet in the early morning, and I can focus before messages start arriving.
Q2: The hardest part is separating work time from personal time. Sometimes I continue checking tasks long after I planned to finish.
Q3: I would prefer a flexible schedule with a few fixed meeting hours. That way, everyone would know when to collaborate, but we could still choose the quietest time to complete individual tasks.
tips_md:
**VSTEP Part 1 – thói quen làm việc:**
- Trả lời ba câu riêng biệt, mỗi câu có **ý chính + lý do + một chi tiết**.
- Câu 1 nêu địa điểm và khoảng thời gian; câu 2 dùng **the hardest part is...** để diễn đạt khó khăn.
- Câu 3 chọn rõ **fixed** hay **flexible**, có thể thêm một điều kiện để cân bằng.
- Giữ thời lượng khoảng 20–25 giây mỗi câu; tránh biến câu 1 thành bài mô tả quá dài.

title: VSTEP Part 1: Dealing with Technical Problems
prompt:
VSTEP Speaking Part 1, social interaction. Answer questions about everyday technology.
1. What was the last technical problem you experienced?
2. Do you normally try to solve a problem yourself before asking for help?
3. What technology would you like to understand better?
sample_answer:
Q1: Last week, my laptop could not connect to the office Wi-Fi. I restarted the connection and checked whether my colleagues had the same issue.
Q2: Yes, I usually try one or two simple steps first. If they do not work, I explain the error clearly to our support team.
Q3: I would like to understand cloud storage better, especially how to organize files and control access. Those skills would help me collaborate without accidentally sharing private documents.
tips_md:
**VSTEP Part 1 – xử lý trục trặc công nghệ:**
- Câu 1 dùng **past simple** để kể lỗi và bước kiểm tra đầu tiên.
- Câu 2 thể hiện cách hành động có trình tự **try simple steps → ask for help**.
- Câu 3 chọn một mảng công nghệ nhỏ và nêu công dụng thực tế, ví dụ quyền truy cập tệp.
- Luyện **connect**, **restart**, **support team**, **cloud storage**; giải thích thuật ngữ bằng tiếng Anh đơn giản.

title: VSTEP Part 1: Notes and Reminders
prompt:
VSTEP Speaking Part 1, social interaction. Discuss how you remember information.
1. Do you prefer paper notes or digital notes?
2. When do you usually review your notes?
3. Have you ever forgotten an important task, and what did you learn from it?
sample_answer:
Q1: I prefer digital notes because I can search for a topic quickly and keep everything in one folder.
Q2: I review them at the end of the day, especially after a meeting or a class with many new ideas.
Q3: Once I forgot to send a document before a team deadline. I apologized and sent it as soon as I noticed. Since then, I have added reminders to my calendar and checked my task list every morning.
tips_md:
**VSTEP Part 1 – ghi chú và ghi nhớ:**
- Nêu ưu điểm cụ thể của một phương pháp, ví dụ **search quickly**, **easy to organize**.
- Câu 2 dùng trạng từ chỉ tần suất và tình huống thường xem lại.
- Câu 3 kể ngắn **sự cố → cách khắc phục → thói quen mới**; dùng **since then** để liên kết hiện tại.
- Chú ý quá khứ đơn trong **forgot**, **sent**, **noticed**.

title: VSTEP Part 1: Studying with Others
prompt:
VSTEP Speaking Part 1, social interaction. Answer questions about group learning.
1. Have you ever joined a study group?
2. What makes a study partner helpful?
3. Do you think online study groups are as effective as meeting in person?
sample_answer:
Q1: Yes, I joined a small English practice group last semester. We met every Friday and took turns asking questions.
Q2: A helpful partner gives honest feedback without making other people feel embarrassed. I also appreciate someone who arrives prepared.
Q3: Online groups can be very effective for sharing files and short speaking practice. However, meeting in person may be better for building trust, especially when members are new to one another.
tips_md:
**VSTEP Part 1 – nhóm học tập:**
- Câu 1 dùng một trải nghiệm có thời điểm, tần suất và hoạt động cụ thể.
- Câu 2 nói về **hành vi** của bạn học tốt, không chỉ chọn tính từ *nice* hoặc *smart*.
- Câu 3 đối chiếu hai hình thức bằng **however** và nêu điều kiện phù hợp cho từng loại.
- Luyện các cụm **take turns**, **honest feedback**, **arrive prepared**.

title: VSTEP Part 1: Priorities and Time Management
prompt:
VSTEP Speaking Part 1, social interaction. Talk about planning daily tasks.
1. How do you decide which task to do first?
2. What distracts you most when you are busy?
3. Has your way of managing time changed since you started studying or working?
sample_answer:
Q1: I start with the tasks that have the closest deadlines or affect other people. After that, I work on smaller items.
Q2: Unexpected messages distract me most because I feel tempted to reply immediately. I now check them at set times when possible.
Q3: Definitely. I used to keep every deadline in my head, which was stressful. These days, I put tasks on a calendar and estimate how long each one will take before I begin.
tips_md:
**VSTEP Part 1 – quản lý thời gian:**
- Dùng **closest deadline**, **affect other people** để giải thích tiêu chí ưu tiên.
- Câu 2 nêu một yếu tố gây mất tập trung và cách bạn xử lý.
- Câu 3 so sánh **I used to... / These days I...** để làm nổi bật thay đổi.
- Kiểm tra sự nhất quán thì hiện tại và quá khứ khi nói về thói quen.

title: VSTEP Part 2: Choosing a Software Training Format
prompt:
VSTEP Speaking Part 2, solution discussion. Your company is introducing a new customer database to staff who have different levels of computer experience. You must recommend ONE training format:
A. A two-hour classroom workshop
B. A set of short recorded video lessons
C. One-to-one coaching sessions
Explain your choice, compare it with the other options, and consider the company's needs. You have one minute to prepare and two minutes to speak.
sample_answer: I would recommend a two-hour classroom workshop as the main training format. The new database will affect how employees record customer information, so everyone should receive the same introduction. In a workshop, an instructor can demonstrate basic tasks, let staff practice with sample records and answer questions immediately. This is especially useful for colleagues who are less confident with computers. Short recorded videos are attractive because people can watch them whenever they have time. However, videos alone may leave beginners confused when something on their screen looks different. Individual coaching would offer the most personal attention, but it could take too many staff hours if the company has a large team. I would therefore organize one workshop for each department and provide a brief handout afterward. Staff members who need extra help could ask a colleague or trainer during the first week. This approach is efficient, gives everyone a shared starting point and still allows follow-up support.
tips_md:
**VSTEP Part 2 – chọn hình thức đào tạo:**
- Trong 60 giây chuẩn bị, ghi **my choice / reason 1 / reason 2 / drawbacks of B and C**.
- Chốt rõ **A** ngay đầu rồi gắn với nhu cầu người mới và tính thống nhất của quy trình.
- So sánh **B** về sự linh hoạt, **C** về hỗ trợ cá nhân, chỉ ra hạn chế tương ứng.
- Kết bằng cách triển khai cụ thể; tránh nói cả ba lựa chọn đều tốt mà không chọn một.

title: VSTEP Part 2: Responding to a Missed Project Deadline
prompt:
VSTEP Speaking Part 2, solution discussion. A small software team has missed an internal deadline because a feature required more testing than expected. You need to choose the best immediate response:
A. Release the feature without completing the tests
B. Inform stakeholders, revise the schedule, and finish testing
C. Remove the feature without consulting anyone
Choose one option and justify it against the other two.
sample_answer: I would choose option B, which is to explain the delay to stakeholders, agree on a realistic new date and complete the testing. The team may feel pressure to deliver quickly, but a reliable feature is more valuable than one that creates problems for users. I would first ask the developers to estimate the remaining tests and identify any serious defects. Then I would send a short update explaining what has been completed, why extra time is required and when the next progress report will arrive. Option A is risky because an unfinished feature could damage customer trust or require an expensive emergency fix. Option C might reduce the team's workload, but removing the feature without discussion could disrupt other plans. Communication is therefore essential. We should present the revised schedule alongside the remaining work and offer a demonstration of the parts already functioning. This shows that the team takes responsibility and has a practical plan for delivering a stable result.
tips_md:
**VSTEP Part 2 – trễ hạn dự án:**
- Chọn **B** và nêu trực tiếp mục tiêu **quality, transparency, realistic schedule**.
- Trình bày hành động theo thứ tự **check remaining work → inform stakeholders → revise deadline**.
- Khi bác bỏ **A** và **C**, nêu hậu quả cụ thể của từng phương án, tránh lặp *bad choice*.
- Luyện ngôn ngữ giao tiếp công việc **progress update**, **stakeholders**, **take responsibility**.

title: VSTEP Part 2: Protecting Team Project Files
prompt:
VSTEP Speaking Part 2, solution discussion. Your project team frequently edits shared design files. Choose the most practical approach to keeping safe copies:
A. Save everything only on one employee's laptop
B. Use an approved shared drive with automatic version history and restricted access
C. Ask everyone to email a copy of each file every Friday
Explain your choice, its benefits and why the other approaches are less suitable.
sample_answer: I would recommend option B, an approved shared drive with version history and appropriate access controls. Our design files change every day, so the team needs a dependable way to recover an earlier version if someone accidentally deletes important work. A shared drive would also make collaboration easier because everyone could use the same current file instead of passing many copies around. However, we should choose a service approved by the organization and make sure permissions are reviewed regularly. Option A creates a serious weakness because a laptop can fail or be lost. Option C may sound simple, but weekly email attachments become outdated quickly, and people may accidentally edit the wrong version. With option B, we could organize files by project, limit editing rights to the relevant members and occasionally test whether an older version can be restored. That would protect the team's work while reducing confusion during busy periods.
tips_md:
**VSTEP Part 2 – bảo vệ tệp dự án:**
- Bắt đầu bằng **I would recommend B** rồi giải thích hai lợi ích **recovery** và **collaboration**.
- So sánh **one laptop** với rủi ro mất máy, **weekly emails** với rủi ro phiên bản cũ.
- Nêu ít nhất một hành động bảo mật cụ thể như **restrict access**, **review permissions**, **test restoration**.
- Dùng thuật ngữ dễ hiểu; tránh mô tả kỹ thuật sao lưu quá sâu ngoài yêu cầu bài nói.

title: VSTEP Part 2: Collecting Feedback on a New App
prompt:
VSTEP Speaking Part 2, solution discussion. A community center is testing a new appointment-booking app with a limited budget. Which feedback method should it prioritize?
A. Short interviews with five people who have just used the app
B. A large advertising campaign asking for online ratings
C. A suggestion box that staff check once per month
Select the best method and explain how the center should use the results.
sample_answer: I would choose option A, short interviews with five people immediately after they use the app. At this early stage, the center needs to understand where users become confused, so specific feedback is more valuable than a large number of general ratings. An interviewer could ask participants to book a trial appointment, describe what they expected to happen and point out any unclear buttons. This process would reveal practical problems that the team could fix before inviting more people. Option B would cost money and might attract ratings from people who have barely used the app. Option C is inexpensive, but monthly reviews would delay improvements and the comments might lack useful detail. After the interviews, I would group the findings into common issues, fix the most frequent ones and repeat the exercise with a few new users. That would give the center a simple, affordable cycle of testing and improvement.
tips_md:
**VSTEP Part 2 – lấy phản hồi ứng dụng:**
- Dựa vào hai điều kiện **limited budget** và **early testing** để bảo vệ lựa chọn A.
- Nêu câu hỏi phỏng vấn cụ thể, ví dụ khó tìm nút hoặc thao tác đặt lịch.
- Phản biện B về chi phí và chất lượng đánh giá, C về tốc độ phản hồi.
- Kết thúc bằng vòng lặp **collect → group → fix → retest** để giải pháp có tính thực thi.

title: VSTEP Part 2: Welcoming a Remote Colleague
prompt:
VSTEP Speaking Part 2, solution discussion. A new employee is joining a fully remote IT support team. Choose ONE main onboarding activity for their first week:
A. Give them a folder of policies to read independently
B. Arrange daily short shadowing sessions with an experienced teammate
C. Ask them to handle a full customer queue alone on day one
Discuss the advantages of your choice and the risks of the other options.
sample_answer: My preferred option is B, daily short shadowing sessions with an experienced teammate. IT support work involves both technical steps and communication with customers, so a new employee benefits from seeing how real requests are handled. During the sessions, the experienced colleague could explain how to prioritize tickets, protect customer information and write a clear response. The new employee could then try one simple case while receiving feedback. Reading policies, as in option A, is still useful, but written documents cannot answer every question or show the team's usual tone. Option C would be unfair to the new colleague and risky for customers because they may not understand the systems yet. I would keep the shadowing sessions short and focused, perhaps thirty minutes each morning, and finish the week with a discussion of remaining questions. This would build confidence while allowing the employee to become independent gradually.
tips_md:
**VSTEP Part 2 – hội nhập nhân viên từ xa:**
- Nhắc rõ đặc điểm của **IT support** gồm nghiệp vụ kỹ thuật và giao tiếp khách hàng.
- Chọn **B** và nêu lộ trình **observe → try a simple ticket → receive feedback**.
- Giải thích vì sao A thiếu tương tác và C tạo rủi ro cho người mới, khách hàng.
- Dùng **shadowing**, **prioritize tickets**, **gradually** chính xác, không nhồi thuật ngữ.

title: VSTEP Part 3: Making Digital Services Accessible
prompt:
VSTEP Speaking Part 3, topic development. Topic: Public digital services should be easy for everyone to use. Develop these points:
- Simple language and clear instructions
- Support for people with limited digital experience
- Alternative ways to access essential services
Then discuss: Should public offices move all services online? How can citizens help improve digital services?
sample_answer: I believe digital public services can save time, but they should be designed around the needs of different citizens. First, websites should use simple language and clear instructions. For example, instead of displaying a complicated technical error, a form could explain which document is missing and how to upload it. Second, people with limited digital experience need practical support. Community centers could offer short lessons, while trained staff could guide visitors through common tasks such as booking an appointment or checking an application status. Third, essential services should remain accessible through more than one channel. Some people have unreliable internet connections or cannot use a smartphone easily. A telephone service or an in-person help desk would make a significant difference to them. For these reasons, I do not think every public service should move exclusively online. Digital systems can become the main option, but citizens should still have ways to get help. Residents can also contribute by reporting confusing instructions, describing accessibility problems and suggesting improvements based on real experiences. A successful digital service is one that people can actually use with confidence.
tips_md:
**VSTEP Part 3 – tiếp cận dịch vụ số:**
- Trong 60 giây, vẽ ba nhánh **clear language / assisted access / alternative channels**.
- Mỗi nhánh theo công thức **point → practical example → benefit**; tránh nêu ý rồi bỏ trống.
- Phần câu hỏi mở rộng phải trả lời cả việc chuyển toàn bộ lên mạng và cách người dân đóng góp.
- Dùng **first**, **second**, **third**, **for these reasons** để người nghe theo dõi bố cục ba phút.

title: VSTEP Part 3: Using AI Assistants Responsibly
prompt:
VSTEP Speaking Part 3, topic development. Topic: AI assistants can support daily work when people use them responsibly. Develop these points:
- Saving time on routine tasks
- Checking accuracy and protecting sensitive information
- Preserving human judgment and communication
Then discuss: Should employees disclose when they use AI to prepare important documents? What skills should schools teach?
sample_answer: AI assistants can be useful in the workplace, especially for repetitive tasks. For example, an employee might ask a tool to suggest an outline for a meeting summary or generate ideas for organizing a project checklist. This can free up time for work that requires careful thought. However, the employee must review every important statement because AI-generated content can contain errors or misunderstand the situation. Sensitive customer records and internal passwords should never be entered into an unapproved service. Another important point is human judgment. A tool may suggest polite wording for a difficult email, but the employee still needs to decide what is fair, accurate and appropriate for the relationship. I believe people should be transparent about substantial AI assistance in important documents when that information matters to colleagues or readers. Clear workplace guidelines would help everyone know what to disclose. Schools should teach students how to evaluate sources, question confident-sounding answers and explain their own decisions. Learning to write a good prompt is useful, but understanding the limitations of the output is equally important. Used thoughtfully, AI can support people's abilities while keeping them accountable for the final result.
tips_md:
**VSTEP Part 3 – trợ lý AI trong công việc:**
- Ba nhánh lần lượt **efficiency → verification/privacy → human responsibility**.
- Ví dụ chọn việc văn phòng đơn giản và chỉ rõ bước con người phải kiểm tra.
- Ở câu mở rộng, giải thích khi nào việc khai báo dùng AI có ý nghĩa với người đọc và tổ chức.
- Luyện các cụm **review the output**, **sensitive information**, **human judgment**, **accountable**; tránh tuyên bố AI luôn đúng.

title: VSTEP Part 3: Building a Safer Digital Workplace
prompt:
VSTEP Speaking Part 3, topic development. Topic: Good cybersecurity depends on everyday habits. Develop these points:
- Recognizing suspicious messages
- Protecting accounts and shared devices
- Reporting mistakes without delay
Then discuss: Why do employees sometimes ignore security advice? Should companies provide regular practical training?
sample_answer: Cybersecurity is often discussed as a technical issue, but everyday behavior also matters. First, employees should learn to recognize suspicious messages. A message that creates panic or asks someone to open an unexpected attachment deserves a second check through a trusted channel. Second, teams need practical habits for protecting accounts and shared devices. Using strong, unique passwords, enabling an additional sign-in factor where available and locking a computer before leaving a desk can reduce common risks. Third, staff should report mistakes quickly. If someone clicks an unusual link, the best response is to contact the support or security team so the situation can be assessed promptly. People sometimes ignore advice because it is presented as long lists of rules without examples. Others are worried about being blamed for making a mistake. I think companies should provide short, realistic training sessions several times a year. These could include identifying an imitation email or practicing how to report a lost device. A supportive environment makes it more likely that employees will ask for help before a small issue becomes a larger problem.
tips_md:
**VSTEP Part 3 – thói quen an toàn thông tin:**
- Chia ba nhánh **recognize / protect / report** và phát triển mỗi nhánh bằng tình huống thực tế.
- Nói **check through a trusted channel** để nhấn mạnh cách xác minh yêu cầu đáng ngờ.
- Giải thích nguyên nhân nhân viên bỏ qua hướng dẫn bằng hai góc **thiếu ví dụ** và **sợ bị trách**.
- Đề xuất tập huấn ngắn, có thực hành và hỗ trợ; duy trì giọng khuyến khích thay vì đe dọa.

title: VSTEP Part 3: Reducing Technology Waste at Work
prompt:
VSTEP Speaking Part 3, topic development. Topic: Offices can reduce environmental waste from technology. Develop these points:
- Maintaining devices for longer use
- Choosing energy-efficient working habits
- Reusing or recycling equipment responsibly
Then discuss: Who should pay for sustainable office technology? Can individual employees make a real difference?
sample_answer: Modern offices rely on laptops, screens and network equipment, so they should think carefully about how these devices are used. The first step is maintenance. Cleaning equipment, replacing a worn battery when appropriate and repairing minor problems can extend a device's useful life. This reduces the need to buy replacements too often. The second step is energy efficiency. Teams can switch off unused monitors, adjust power settings and avoid running equipment unnecessarily outside working hours. Small actions can become meaningful when many employees participate. The third step is responsible reuse and recycling. A company should remove confidential information from retired devices, check whether they can be reassigned and use reputable collection services for equipment that can no longer be used. I believe employers should cover the main costs of sustainable systems because they make purchasing and disposal decisions. However, employees also have an important role. They can report faulty devices promptly, follow power-saving guidance and suggest practical improvements. The aim should be to reduce waste while keeping the workplace reliable and productive, rather than replacing working equipment simply because a newer model is available.
tips_md:
**VSTEP Part 3 – công nghệ bền vững:**
- Phát triển ba ý theo vòng đời thiết bị **maintain → use efficiently → reuse/recycle**.
- Mỗi điểm cần ví dụ và hệ quả, chẳng hạn kéo dài thời gian sử dụng hoặc giảm điện năng.
- Khi bàn trách nhiệm chi phí, phân biệt quyết định mua sắm của doanh nghiệp với thói quen hằng ngày của nhân viên.
- Dùng **extend useful life**, **retired devices**, **power settings**; chú ý bước xử lý dữ liệu trước khi tái sử dụng.

title: VSTEP Part 3: Learning New Technology Throughout a Career
prompt:
VSTEP Speaking Part 3, topic development. Topic: Continuing to learn technology skills benefits both workers and organizations. Develop these points:
- Adapting to changing tools
- Sharing knowledge with teammates
- Building confidence through small projects
Then discuss: Is formal training always necessary? How can employers help busy staff keep learning?
sample_answer: Learning technology skills throughout a career is important because the tools people use can change quickly. First, workers need enough confidence to adapt when a company introduces a new system. This does not mean they must become technical experts. They may simply need to learn how to enter information correctly or solve common problems. Second, sharing knowledge helps an entire team. An employee who discovers a useful feature can demonstrate it during a short meeting or write a simple guide for colleagues. Third, practical projects make learning more memorable. For example, someone who wants to improve spreadsheet skills could build a basic monthly expense tracker and gradually add formulas. I do not think formal training is always necessary. Courses are helpful when a subject is complex or a qualification is required, but peer learning and careful practice can also be effective. Employers could support busy staff by reserving a small amount of learning time each week, offering access to appropriate resources and recognizing people who share useful knowledge. A culture of steady improvement is more sustainable than expecting everyone to master a new tool overnight.
tips_md:
**VSTEP Part 3 – học công nghệ suốt đời:**
- Sắp xếp ba nhánh **adapt to tools / share knowledge / build a small project**.
- Dùng ví dụ bảng tính hoặc ứng dụng công việc quen thuộc để bài nói dễ hình dung.
- Trả lời rõ câu hỏi **Is formal training always necessary?** bằng lập trường có điều kiện.
- Đề xuất hỗ trợ thực tế như **weekly learning time** và **peer demonstrations**, rồi kết bằng lợi ích dài hạn.
